## Kushagra OS 2.1

An iOS-style mobile experience, and a single default link for the portfolio.

**Live:** https://kushagra486.github.io (the same link works on phones and desktops)

### iOS-style mobile view

On phones (screens narrower than 640px), the portfolio now looks and behaves like iOS:

- **Status bar** with a Dynamic Island-style pill that expands to show the app you just opened (tap it to search), plus signal, Wi-Fi and battery icons that open the widgets view.
- **Home screen** with swipeable pages: a profile widget and apps on page 1, the live GitHub contributions widget and the remaining apps on page 2, with page dots and a Search pill.
- **Jiggle mode**: long-press any icon, as on iOS.
- **Dock** with four apps (About Me, Projects, AI Assistant, Contact) and a home indicator.
- **Full-screen apps** with an iOS "‹ Home" back button; tap or swipe up on the home indicator to go home.
- **Widgets view** that blurs the home screen behind it.

The desktop keeps the macOS design from 2.0, unchanged.

### One default link

- The old Vercel address (kushagra486-github-io.vercel.app) now redirects to https://kushagra486.github.io. The `/api/...` endpoints behind the AI Assistant, JD Matcher and Contact form keep working.
- The site declares kushagra486.github.io as its canonical address for search engines.
- The GitHub profile README now links to the portfolio.

### Download

`kushagra-os-v2.1.zip` holds the static build. Serve the folder with any static file server.
